net_revenue_usd.decision_use: Primary forecast target after recognized refunds

shipped_revenue_usd.definition: Value released from the modeled fulfillment backlog subject to daily capacity
shipped_revenue_usd.decision_use: Distinguishes commercial demand from fulfillment realization

revenue_to_ship_gap_usd.decision_use: Daily pressure signal; may be negative when prior backlog is cleared

marketing_efficiency_ratio.decision_use: Predictive planning ratio, not a causal ROAS claim

net_revenue_yoy_pct.definition: Percent change from the observation 365 days earlier
net_revenue_yoy_pct.decision_use: Separates growth from recurring annual seasonality
